items.content_html: RSNA knee MRI (Kaggle): 12 abnormalities, AUROC 0.942 public / 0.928 private. Only 58 of 4,407 studies had image labels, so labels came from reports in 9 languages via LLMs + MedGemma, refined by OOF teachers. ConvNeXt, DINOv3, SwinV2, MRI-CORE and MedImageInsight ensembles read up to 96 sagittal, coronal, axial slices; trained on H100/H200s.
